variants.name: namaqualand_cliff_02
variants.notes: Jointed granite outcrop, OPEN shell: front = +Z, long axis = X, top is modelled; the back (-Z) and underside are open and must sit inside terrain. Visible from azimuths within about 75 deg of +Z and from above. The bottom edge is within 0.5 m of the base over the central ~12 m and climbs to 2.7 m (x = -10) / 4.0 m (x = +10) at the ends (see baseProfile): let the terrain rise at both ends or cover them with boulders.

variants.name: rock_face_01
variants.notes: Bedded rock face with a mossy overhanging ledge on top, OPEN shell: front = +Z, the face leans back (see faceSlopeDeg) so the top is ~7 m behind the base; back (-Z) is open and must sit inside the slope. Scaled x2 from the scan. Can be pitched forward up to ~25 deg for a steeper road cut.

variants.name: mountainside
variants.notes: Large scaly (slate-like) mountain wall, OPEN shell: front = +Z, back (-Z) is open and must sit inside the mountain. In plan it is a shallow V (centre closest to the viewer). Tolerates uniform scale up to ~1.8 when further than ~15 m from the camera.
